content.text:
Is Micron a Commodity or an AI Powerhouse? The Debate Driving MU’s Low Valuation.
The paradox of Micron is that even as its stock has soared 700% over the past year, it still has an underwhelming valuation. That’s because memory chips are viewed as a cyclical commodity–in the same basket as wheat or copper.
